exchanges.author: c_kevin
exchanges.body: Fair enough. Thanks, Imani.

exchanges.author: worker
exchanges.body: Kevin Lindqvist (Senate Ways and Means staff), after the HB 1214 release. # Z-0388.1/27 (SBCTC agency request, apprenticeship instruction report): DWT fiscal note draft

Fiscal impact: greater than zero but less than $50,000 per fiscal year.

What the bill does for DWT: section 2 requires a joint DWT-SBCTC annual report on related supplemental instruction for registered apprentices, starting December 1, 2028. DWT's share: matching apprentice registration records to SBCTC enrollment data and writing DWT's sections.

Assumptions: 0.3 FTE Research Analyst ($84,000) from July 1, 2027, ongoing; benefits at OFM's standard 33.5%; goods and services $8,000 per FTE; a one-time sponsor survey in FY2028 ($12,000) to collect instruction costs not in either agency's data. Least-cost approach: existing systems, no new software.

| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |

# Apprenticeship (Program C) reduction options, 2027-29 (draft for Hannah)

Target: 5% of the FY2027 allotment ($8,440,000) = $422,000 a year. Benefits at OFM's 33.5% for 2027-29.

| Option | Per year | 2027-29 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| (a) Eliminate the two consultant positions still vacant (2 x $78,000 x 1.335) | 208,260 | 416,520 |
| (b) End the two sponsor outreach contracts | 90,000 | 180,000 |
| (c) Reduce in-state travel 30% of $80,000 | 24,000 | 48,000 |
| (d) Registration renewals online only (printing and mail) | 18,500 | 37,000 |
| Total | 340,760 | 681,520 |

The options reach 4.04%, $81,240 a year short of 5%.

Notes: Luis's list counted three vacant positions ($312,390), but position 70412 is being filled December 1, so only two remain, and those two are planned for hire March 1 (our answer to OFM question 7 says they're needed). Choosing (a) means cancelling those hires. The navigator pilot is one-time FY2027 money and isn't affected. (b) does not include AP-27-012 (Cascade Pathways), whose FY2028 $40,000 is subject to appropriation. Luis should add options to close the $81,240 gap or accept a smaller share.
